guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails to build because of an incompatible npm version installation step. Specifically, after installing Node.js v18.20.8 from NodeSource, running `npm install -g npm@latest` attempts to install npm@11.16.0, which requires Node.js >=20.17.0 or >=22.9.0, but the installed Node.js version is 18.20.8, causing an npm 'Unsupported engine' error and breaking the build. To fix this: update the Node.js installation to a supported version (>=20.17.0), for example, use the NodeSource setup script for Node.js 20.x instead of 18.x (https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x). Alternatively, do not upgrade npm to latest globally and use the npm version that comes with Node.js 18.x for compatibility. This issue makes the environment setup incomplete, so tests cannot be executed.
